SELECT rs.round_seat_id, g.grade_name, g.surcharge, w.work_price, (w.work_price + g.surcharge) AS price FROM round_seat rs JOIN seat s ON rs.seat_id = s.seat_id /* g.grade_id가 아니라 g.seat_grade_id일 것입니다 */ JOIN seat_grade g ON s.seat_grade_id = g.seat_grade_id JOIN round r ON rs.round_id = r.round_id JOIN work w ON r.work_id = w.work_id WHERE rs.round_seat_id IN
#{id}
